bugs.what: A 'free' menu option ('weigh what each choice would mean', 'get your bearings', etc.) sometimes silently advances the scene/turn counter or reshuffles the menu numbering between pages, making a chosen number occasionally resolve to the wrong listed action (e.g. selecting 'the old king's steel' produced a farewell line instead, and once a page-2 option list caused an unintended 'go north' instead of the intended dialogue pick).
bugs.where: The Forge / Captain Vane's Tent multi-page menus

bugs.what: Companions can be dropped to critically low HP (1/9) or knocked down ('crawls clear of the fight') by 'armor useless' undead in scripted corridor fights with no in-fiction way to heal them short of a distant hearth; only self-targeted heal items exist, so a long dungeon push (Coldpass→Marrowgate→crypts) has no mid-dungeon safety valve.
bugs.where: The Ring-Ditch / The Old Crypts barrow-wight and honour-guard fights

bugs.what: Skill-check DC creep from repeated failure (e.g. wind-carvings puzzle) can spiral (DC rising each miss) with no way to just walk away and return later with a different approach besides switching stats, which isn't well telegraphed as a strategy.
bugs.where: Old Watchtower / Sunken Shrine verse puzzles

confusions: The path from the Vale to Coldpass/Marrowgate is not signposted in the region overview text as clearly as in-hold bearings are; I had to wander through the Kingswood and several dead-end lore rooms before finding the actual Wardmoor→Coldpass road.

It's unclear until very late that 'read the founding ledger aloud to those who trust you' is itself a standalone ending — it's only mentioned in the Act 3 status blurb, never offered as a menu action anywhere I found it.

Whether killing/knocking down a companion in a forced fight has any permanent consequence (do they truly die, or just recover at next rest?) is never stated, which made the honour-guard encounter feel riskier than the game maybe intended.
suggestions: Add a direct 'toward Coldpass' bearing hint earlier (e.g. at the Vale gate or in Act 2's status text) once 3 hollows are rested, instead of requiring the player to discover the Wardmoor road organically.
Surface 'read the ledger aloud' and the other Act 3 endings as explicit menu options at the throne room / palace court, not just prose in the status recap.

Give a portable minor party-heal item or a 'catch your breath' free action in multi-room dungeons that lack a hearth, so a single bad initiative round doesn't threaten to end a companion's arc right before the finale.
Cap or reset check-DC creep after leaving and re-entering a room, so failed puzzles don't become effectively unsolvable for a given build without a stat perk.
